messages:
elaine_docs: Quick sync: drafting a focused v1->v2 migration doc that covers API param rename, streaming differences, and the embed model swap. Need owners for snippets, banner copy, and a reindex example.

tom_sdk: I can do JS + Python snippets and a short SDK changelog bullet. Will default examples to `model_id`.

anya_prod: Hosted will swap to v2 defaults next Thursday (18:00 UTC). Dedicated customers have a 14-day opt-in. Docs should show exact dates and opt-in steps.

ben_infra: Note: we will not auto-translate streaming semantics. We'll provide a small compat helper for sync requests only. I'll provide a 3-line snippet.

frank_qa: I'll own smoke tests and the reindex snippet for pgvector. Add me to the PR.

elaine_docs: Plan: 1) short banner for API reference, 2) migration section (old vs new examples), 3) streaming checklist, 4) embed vector compatibility + reindex snippet, 5) FAQ.

tom_sdk: Draft changelog line: "SDK breaking: `model` renamed to `model_id`; streaming validation tightened. Update callsites and test streaming flows."

elaine_docs: Good. Examples: ```js
// v1
client.generate({ model: 'redwood/v1-small', prompt: 'hi' })
// v2
client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood/v2-efficiency', prompt: 'hi' })
```

ben_infra: Compat helper (py): ```py
if 'model' in req: req['model_id'] = req.pop('model')
# WARNING: streaming frames not handled by this shim
```

frank_qa: Reindex pseudo-cmd to include: `python tools/reindex_vectors.py --src legacy --dst v2 --model redwood/v2-embed-xl` + note to ALTER table dims if using pgvector.

anya_prod: FAQ items: keys won't break; latency may vary by model (link to catalog). Add opt-in how-to for Dedicated (console + support).

elaine_docs: I'll make a short banner: "Notice: v1 endpoints are on the deprecation path. See migration guide." Will open a draft PR with owners listed and ping #docs-review when ready. :sparkles:

docs-ci: CI scheduled: branch `docs/migrate/v1v2` lint + smoke at 2024-11-04T07:00:00Z.

frank_qa: I'll run the smoke suite after PR lands and post results.

elaine_docs: Thanks team — aim to land draft by Wed AM so we have a day before the hosted flip.
